baseline.first: SOURCE parser rejects the flat percent expression
baseline.later: CHECK, owned result, emit and guest not reached

positive.form: let/Copy/tail, aligned zero distinguished from Unknown
explicit RETURN, equal remainders from three actuals with fresh call/result identities
direct tail; numerator below the maximum divisor stays intact

negative.failure: definition CHECK, exact core usize type
definition CHECK, Known-only precision limit even with a favorable actual

stages.source: Accept one selected name % typed usize literal in existing positions. Keep zero syntactically meaningful and defer operator grammar expansion.
stages.check: Exact core usize, current Copy numerator, target representable nonzero divisor. Unknown stays Unknown at definition and through Copy. Each actual produces a fresh r = n % k, with 0 <= r < k.
stages.owned: Public operation-specific receipt binds retained source and exact operator/operand spans, value and binding identities, target and optional facts. Division and remainder stay disjoint when both results are zero. Reject foreign source/receipt, substituted result ID even with the same number, wrong operator/span and fabricated Known. The full consumer checks existing per-call and complete-result/world custody.
stages.emit: Strict C17 computes % with the real actual and nonzero/target guards. Observe every value listed under caller through the real guest in GCC, Clang, ASan and UBSan configurations. Exit zero alone is insufficient.
stages.failures: Named output stays unchanged on refused source. Hit receipt allocation, result seal and emission staging in real host code; retain context/output on failure and check pristine retry. Preserve original control cases.
stages.boundary: Reuse the existing one-helper scalar family, ordinary lets and Copies, unit caller and proven Known-only plus/minus. No dynamic divisor, general expression syntax, new permissive range or custody machinery. Mixed helper/operator graphs beyond this family remain separate work.
